change: release.yml takes two optional secrets, RELEASE_APP_ID and RELEASE_APP_KEY, for a release GitHub App: on a push to main it mints a token for that repository alone with contents write (actions/create-github-app-token), and the checkout, `pubrel tag`'s tag push and the GitHub release use it, so a tag ruleset can name the app as its bypass actor where an organization cannot name GitHub Actions. Without them it uses the workflow's own token as before; pull request and merge queue runs never mint it
